options.label: 完全素颜 (Raw Skin)
options.value: no makeup look, bare skin texture, visible natural pores, slight natural redness, unstyled eyebrows, clean and fresh aesthetic, raw realism

options.label: 伪素颜 (No-Makeup Makeup)
options.value: clean 'no-makeup' makeup look, sheer foundation, groomed natural brows, clear lip balm, subtle inner eyeliner, transparent and airy vibe

options.label: 奶油肌 (Cream Skin)
options.value: cream skin finish, semi-matte foundation, natural pore visibility, subtle highlighter on nose bridge, gentle and clean appearance

options.label: 水光感 (Dewy/Glass Skin)
options.value: k-beauty glass skin makeup, high-shine dewy finish, hydrating glow, glossy pink lips, pastel pink eyeshadow, youthful and sweet

options.label: 宿醉腮红 (Igari/Drunk)
options.value: Igari style makeup (drunk blush), heavy pink blush across nose bridge and cheeks, watery eyes, smudged lips, vulnerable and cute atmosphere

options.label: 碎钻闪片 (Glitter)
options.value: peach blossom makeup, sparkling glitter particles on eyelids and under-eyes (aegyo-sal), gradient jelly lips, romantic fairy vibe

options.label: 大地色系 (Earth Tone)
options.value: sophisticated earth tone makeup, matte brown eyeshadow, subtle contouring for depth, nude MLBB lipstick, professional and polished

options.label: 泰式轻泰妆 (Thai Light)
options.value: soft Thai style makeup, wild distinct eyebrows (bushy brows), sun-kissed apricot blush, matte blurred lips, energetic and confident

options.label: 白开水妆 (Clean Girl)
options.value: clean girl aesthetic, minimal makeup, slicked back hair, soap brows, glowing healthy skin, rosy cheeks, effortless chic

options.label: 复古红唇 (Vintage Red)
options.value: classic vintage Hong Kong style makeup, matte full red lipstick, sharp black eyeliner, defined eyebrows, high contrast, cinematic allure

options.label: 轻烟熏 (Soft Smokey)
options.value: soft smokey eye makeup, grey-brown eyeshadow, voluminous mascara, nude lip color, mysterious and sexy, evening look

options.label: Y2K千禧风
options.value: Y2K playful makeup, frosty blue or metallic eyeshadow, heavy highlighter, glossy lips, bold eyeliner, retro-futuristic vibe

options.label: 哭泣妆 (Crying)
options.value: tear-stained makeup, red puffy eyes, wet cheeks, smudged mascara, glossy lips, emotional and heartbreaking beauty

options.label: 雀斑晒伤 (Sunkissed)
options.value: summer sunkissed makeup, heavy bronzer, scattered natural freckles across nose and cheeks, orange-toned blush, vacation vibe

options.label: 哥特/暗黑 (Gothic)
options.value: soft gothic makeup, dark plum lipstick, pale skin, dark eyeliner, cool toned aesthetic, edgy and rebellious
